title: Plan AS: AI Travel Planning
summary: Preferences → itinerary → transport & stay → checklist → live adjustments
scenario: For independent and family travelers who want a workable itinerary fast and the flexibility to adjust it on the road.

steps.title: Collect preferences
steps.detail: Write down party size, days, budget, dates, interests (food/culture/nature/family), pace preference, and whether seniors or kids are along. Let the model ask the constraints you forgot to mention, like dietary restrictions or limited mobility.
steps.tips: List what you absolutely won't do — for example, no rushing between sights — as its own line; that saves more worry than listing what you want.

steps.title: Itinerary
steps.detail: Have the model draft a day-by-day itinerary: daily theme, sight order, rough timing, and geographic routing that avoids backtracking. Mark how long to allow at each spot plus alternates for rain or fatigue.
steps.tips: Ask for a route ordered by map geography and one droppable flexible item per day — cut it instantly when legs give out.

steps.title: Transport & stay
steps.detail: Use Perplexity for transport options between sights (bus/metro/private car) and travel times, Google Maps to verify locations and opening hours, and booking platforms to compare hotels and guesthouses, prioritizing base areas near the main activity zone.
steps.tips: Have the model suggest where to stay that minimizes commuting to the major sights, then confirm prices on the platform.

steps.title: Checklist
steps.detail: Consolidate the itinerary, booking numbers, addresses, phone numbers, packing list and emergency contacts into a Notion travel page readable offline on your phone. Export each day's plan as a shareable checklist for the group.
steps.tips: Build a 'before-you-leave' list — documents, cash, chargers, medicine, weather — and check it off the night before departure.

steps.title: Live adjustments
steps.detail: When a sight closes, weather changes, or energy drops, tell the model your current time and location and have it re-plan just today's remaining stops. Check real-time opening hours and crowds on Google Maps before deciding.
steps.tips: After every adjustment, have the model replan only the rest of today — don't tear up the next few days.

pitfalls.title: Relying on stale information
pitfalls.detail: Opening hours, ticket prices and transport lines change constantly; verify on official sites and Google Maps before you go, and keep the schedule loose.

pitfalls.title: Over-packing the itinerary
pitfalls.detail: A checklist-style itinerary collapses at the first queue or traffic jam; keep 1-2 droppable items and some free time every day.

pitfalls.title: Trusting AI without booking
pitfalls.detail: AI suggestions need actual confirmation on official sites or platforms — don't live in the illusion of 'already booked'; also read the change policies.

pitfalls.title: One pace for the whole family
pitfalls.detail: If you plan at a young adult's pace with seniors or kids along, everyone's exhausted by day three; design daily intensity around the slowest member.
